messages:
alex_cs: Heads up — NebulaOps go-live for their dedicated pool is scheduled Thu 09:00 UTC next week. Need to lock quota plan, autoscale profiles, and a short load sweep. Who can take ownership of the traffic scripts?

jess_support: I can coordinate with the customer for traffic patterns and acceptance criteria. Will capture expected RPS, tail-LL, and spike scenarios by EOD today.

sam_ops: I'll own infra side (pool sizing + quota). Quick ask: do we want linear autoscale or step-based for first 48h? Suggest step-based with conservative cooldowns.

li-engr: Step-based makes sense for initial bring-up. Also recommend a KV cache priming window before we ramp. If they send long context, we should pre-warm top prefixes to avoid cold tails.

alex_cs: Good call. jess, please get customer traffic heatmap. sam, propose step sizes (v1 suggestion below).

sam_ops: Proposed autoscale profile (first draft):
```
- start quota: 200 rps reserved
- step1: +100 rps at 2m cooldown (10m sustain)
- step2: +300 rps at 5m cooldown (20m sustain)
- burst: allow +20% for 5m with backoff
- headroom target: 30% reserved
```
I can post as config snippet into the infra repo.

alex_cs: Nice. Tune headroom to 25% if customer SLAs allow it — lower cost.

toni_sre: FYI, I'll run a tail-latency monitor and wire up alerting rules: P95/P99, GPU memory pressure, and request queue depth. Also will add a temporary slack alert to this thread channel for incidents.

li-engr: Load test infra note: use k6 for RPS profile + a small sampling of long prompts to catch KV miss patterns. Example command: `k6 run --vus 150 --duration 15m load-sweep.js` — we'll iterate.

jess_support: I'll send NebulaOps the draft traffic template now and ask them to confirm spike durations and auth keys. Expected return by tomorrow 14:00 UTC.

alex_cs: Can we schedule a 30m pre-flight on Wed to walk-through scripts and canary keys? Prefer 08:30 UTC.

sam_ops: Wed 08:30 works. I'll reserve a dedicated slot and spin up the shadow pool for a smoke test.

li-engr: For the smoke we'll run a short KV-priming job (5m), then 10m at 50% of planned, then ramp to 100%. I'll provide the priming script.

alex_cs: Risk items: renewal uplift if latency spikes >10% during first week. Capture this in the runbook and add rollback-to-hosted plan.

jess_support: Noted — I'll add a renewal-risk flag to the customer ticket and include mitigation steps.

toni_sre: Also recommend a rollback traffic-shift plan: 10m cool-down, drop to fallback model variant, divert 30% to hosted for 20m. I'll draft runbook steps.

deploy-bot: Scheduled: smoke-pool spin-up at 2026-04-15T08:15:00Z (job id: smoke-3345123456).

alex_cs: Perfect. After Wed pre-flight, we'll finalize quota commitment and get sign-off from NebulaOps PM. Thanks all.

sam_ops: I'll push the autoscale JSON and link here when done.

li-engr: I'll attach priming script and a short checklist before the preflight.

jess_support: Customer confirmed spike windows and provided sample payloads. Linking in ticket #NEB-207.

alex_cs: Great wrap. We'll reconvene Wed 08:30 UTC in this thread. :thumbsup:
